quantity: relative tracer-derived soil-resource uptake; not root biomass or absolute transpiration

profile_form.beta_unit: dimensionless, using numerical depth in cm
profile_form.check_before_adoption: Confirm depth coding in archived analysis and integrate over the chosen physical layer boundaries.

optional_shrub_size_fit.V: mean aboveground canopy volume of an overlapping group, m^3; not aboveground biomass
optional_shrub_size_fit.limitations: Cross-sectional grouped fit, not individual growth trajectories. Verify the source calculation and a species biomass-to-volume allometry before use.

application_limits: The 2018-2019 experiment used 64 grass-shrub pairs and injections within approximately 1.2 m; restrictive horizons could limit actual depths.
Fitted curves and reported depth-bin summaries are distinct estimates; do not force both to agree exactly.
Choose an explicit treatment for uptake below the modeled bottom; do not silently renormalize or discard it.
The profile is an uptake prior, not a measurement of volumetric root density, daily transpiration, lateral root spread or water-to-biomass efficiency.
No runtime loader, illustrative default, species trait or hydrology implementation is changed.
